_comment: Columns of sand that walk the Age (design 5.2.2). It names the phenomenon rather than searching for
one, which is what `names` is for and what `VocabularyCheck` insists on: a tag query -- 'the burying
one' -- would also have found whatever else buried you.
`deluge` would be the better word and is deliberately not spent here (Jonah, 2026-08-31). It belongs to
the watery flood, which is not written yet; a word spent on the wrong phenomenon is worse than a
plainer one on the right phenomenon.
**One aspect, and the climate is not touched.** A sandfall wants a dry Age and it is not going to ask
for one here: a narrowing word is priced in its lowest-ordinal aspect (`Resolver.pricedIn`) and
phenomena are last, so a rainfall bound in this file would quietly reprice this as a word about
